# libdrm public headers

`xf86drm.h` and `xf86drmMode.h` are unmodified headers from Debian's
`libdrm-dev` package, version `2.4.124-2`. Copyright and permissive license
notices are included in each header. Kernel DRM UAPI headers come from the
Android NDK sysroot. The executable links to the box's existing `libdrm.so`.
